blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla on Saturday, Sept. 19, said that his decision to not run for public office in the 2028 national elections is final, further saying he is not cut out for politics. Previously, he said that he is open to become the running mate of Vice President Sara Duterte after the two became the leading candidates in the hypothetical surveys in the 2028 national elections. The senator, however, withdrew his pronouncement, saying that he is not fit for politics.
